name: springy-cursor
description: Neovide-like animated cursor trail for VS Code

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The cursor trail only patches the local editor UI; it never reads workspace contents, so it is safe in Restricted Mode.

springyCursor.autoEnable.description: Wire the trail up automatically on first run and re-apply it after a VS Code update. Turn off to manage it only through the Enable/Disable commands.

springyCursor.color.description: Trail color as #RGB, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Leave empty to use the theme's cursor color (--vscode-editorCursor-foreground).

springyCursor.glow.description: Draw a glow around the trail (costs some performance).

springyCursor.glowBlur.description: Glow blur radius as a multiple of the cursor size.

enumDescriptions: Shorter, understated trail with quick recovery.
Smooth, cohesive Zed-like cursor glide without hard leading snap.
Use custom animationLength, rankTrailFactors, and snap parameters.

springyCursor.animationLength.description: Animation length in seconds for cursor jumps. Only used when preset is "custom".

springyCursor.shortAnimationLength.description: Animation length in seconds for short moves on the same line, such as typing. Only used when preset is "custom".

springyCursor.animateOnTyping.description: Enable cursor trail for short single-line movements when typing.

springyCursor.animateOnSelection.description: Enable cursor trail while selecting text.

springyCursor.rankTrailFactors.description: Trail duration multipliers for the 4 corners ordered from most trailing (rank 0) to most leading (rank 3). Only used when preset is "custom".

springyCursor.hardSnap.description: Snap leading corners quickly toward the destination for an elastic stretch effect. Only used when preset is "custom".

springyCursor.leadingSnapFactor.description: Animation length multiplier for leading corners when hardSnap is enabled. Only used when preset is "custom".

springyCursor.leadingSnapThreshold.description: Direction alignment threshold (0 to 1) above which a corner is treated as a leading corner. Only used when preset is "custom".
